The '''Corellian Museum of Space Exploration''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in the [[CEC Island|Corellian Engineering Corporation Headquarters]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It retraced the history of the conquest of space travel, from the [[hyperspace cannon]] to the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
